dex.text: Clocks on at six, clocks off when it's done, and hums the whole time. Lands on bollards, bins and buddleia with equal enthusiasm.
dex.fact: The worker bee has been a symbol of Manchester since the Industrial Revolution, standing for the city's hard-working mill hands. It is on the city's coat of arms.

dex.text: A bustling great bee with a red-brick hive for a back and the whole city's work ethic in its legs. Never late. Never off sick. Slightly exhausting to be around.
dex.fact: After the Manchester Arena attack in 2017, thousands of people had worker bee tattoos done to raise money and show the city stood together.
